answer: Proposal: auction K scoring slots per epoch at uniform price, burning proceeds. Code sets supply as quartz sets a watch's beat: demand cannot stretch it. Every extra identity must win a slot, yet the attacker's own bids lift the clearing price paid on all, so N slots cost N times a price rising with N — convex — while slot reward stays capped. No identity census is assumed; constraints are fixed supply and market depth. If honest demand thins to a whisper, floors collapse and sybils buy the epoch cheap; keep rewards capped near clearing price across the attack horizon.
